tickets.name: Open Floor
tickets.note: Pull up a chair for Wizards at Hawks, because the first minute is where the money is! Ayton versus Okongwu for the tip, and Ayton has owned that matchup in the circle! Either side can strike first here, and we like the Hawks to make it count! If Okongwu wins the jump, he seals his man, and that's an easy two to start the night! If that first look rims out, Flemings is right there to clean it up! Any of them scores first, and we're counting money!

tickets.name: Get on the Board
tickets.note: Celtics at Hornets, and the race to the first bucket starts at center court! Queta and Kalkbrenner meet at center court, and it's anybody's tip! Toss-up at the tip, but we trust the Hornets to cash the first trip! The Hornets love to open with Reid, and he takes that first shot with a smile! Allen is right behind him, ready to pounce on any mistake! White rounds it out, the sneaky one, and sneaky is our favorite flavor! Pick your poison, because any of them covers it!

tickets.name: Out of the Huddle
tickets.note: Here comes 76ers at Cavaliers, and the opening tip is where our night begins! Embiid and Mobley for the opening tip, and you could flip a quarter on it! This opening could break either way, and we know which way we're leaning! Mitchell gets the first touch for the Cavaliers, and he's hunting his shot! Mitchell is the only play we like here, and we like him a lot!

tickets.name: Top of the Key
tickets.note: Lights up for Thunder at Grizzlies, and we know exactly who we want touching the ball early! Hartenstein has to deal with Edey in the circle, and that's a tall order, folks! Advantage Grizzlies for the opening bucket. And if the Thunder flip the script, Mitchell is waiting right there to pounce! Just one play in this game, and it's Mitchell all the way!

tickets.name: Off the Tip
tickets.note: Next up, Timberwolves at Pelicans, and the first trip down the floor is circled in red! Gobert and Matkovic meet in the circle, and Gobert has been winning these jumps all season long! That hands the Timberwolves the first possession, and that's half the battle! If the Pelicans get there first, Fears is who we want firing! Nobody else here beats his price, so it's Fears or bust!

tickets.name: Early Offense
tickets.note: It's Raptors and Bucks, and buddy, we've got a plan for the opening act! Poeltl squares up with Turner for the opening tip, and we like Poeltl to control it! That puts the Raptors on the front foot to get on the board first. The Bucks get a stop? Then it's Turner running the other way for the first two! Miss on the first look and Burries is crashing for the putback! The stakes are split so any one of them pays for the whole game. Beautiful!

tickets.name: Lead the Break
tickets.note: Jazz at Mavericks, and here's how we see the opening act! The jump ball goes Hayes against Gafford, and Hayes has the springs tonight! It's up for grabs, and we're holding a ticket on both teams! Bailey is the first option in that opening set, and he does not pass it up! Hayes is lurking on the weak side for the kick-out! If the Mavericks steal the tip or get the first stop, Gafford is who we want firing first! Hit one, cover the game. Simple as that, folks!

tickets.name: Jump Ball
tickets.note: Spurs at Kings. Grab a seat, the first bucket is a story we've already read! Sabonis has to deal with Wembanyama in the circle, and that's a tall order, folks! So the Spurs should get the first crack at it. Should the Kings grab the first possession, Sabonis is our trigger man! And LaVine is the backup plan on that possession, a fine backup plan at that! And Achiuwa sneaks in as the third man, just in case! Any one of them hits and the whole game is paid for. That's how we like it!

COVER-2026-10-28 (owner: "3 likeliest, any edge, weighted so any hit covers the game"): Tip-Off = per game, our model's 3 most likely starters with any edge, 0.6u a game dutched across them (replaces the one-per-game rule posted earlier the same day, and From the Logo / Full-Court Heaves). 10-20..10-27 restated from each board's priced starters at the FanDuel prices on the board.
